ValidationRule.description: Duration (seconds) cannot be negative or exceed the calendar span; day-or-longer durations must render with a day unit.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Duration_Secs__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), OR( Duration_Secs__c < 0, CEILING(Duration_Secs__c / 86400) > (End_Date__c - Start_Date__c) + 1, AND(Duration_Secs__c >= 86400, NOT(CONTAINS(FORMATDURATION(Duration_Secs__c, TRUE), 'd'))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Duration Secs is inconsistent with the Start/End dates.
